help.help-intro: Hello! My name is %s, I am a multifunctional bot created to help you with various tasks and provide entertainment for your group! Take a look at the modules below to get an idea of some things I can help you with. Main commands: - /start - Checks if the bot is active and working, also provides menu options. - /help - Provides information about the bot's modules and how to use them. - /lang - Allows you to change the bot's language to your desired language. All commands can be used with: ! or / as a prefix.
help.here-is-help: Below is the help for the %s module.
help.module-info-error: Sorry, there was a problem getting the module information.
help.module-description-not-found: • The description for the module %s was not found.

afk.afk: With the AFK module, you can set your status to 'Away' to inform others that you are not available at the moment. When someone mentions you or sends a direct message, the bot will automatically respond with your customized AFK message. You can also set a reason for your absence, and the bot will inform when you are back. Main commands: - /afk [reason]: Sets your status to AFK with an optional reason.

android.android: The Android module provides tools for Android devices, including device information, custom ROMs, recoveries, and Magisk releases.
android.lineageos: The LineageOS module allows you to find available LineageOS builds for an Android device. Main commands: - /los | /lineageos [codename]: Lists the available LineageOS builds for the specified device.
android.magisk: The Magisk module allows you to check and download the latest Stable, Beta, and Canary releases of Magisk. Main commands: - /magisk: Shows the latest Magisk releases.
android.twrp: The TWRP module allows you to find available TWRP recoveries for an Android device. Main commands: - /twrp [codename]: Lists the available TWRP recoveries for the specified device.
android.variants: The Variants module allows you to find the manufacturer, model, and codename variants of an Android device. Main commands: - /variants: Lists Android device variants.

lastfm.lastfm: The LastFM module allows you to connect your Last.fm account to the bot and share your music listening activity with others. You can set your Last.fm username, and the bot will be able to retrieve information about the songs you're currently listening to, as well as your listening history. This way, you can share your musical tastes and discoveries with your friends in the chat. Main commands: - /set [username]: Sets your Last.fm username to connect your account with the bot. - /lfm | /lt | /lastfm | lt: Retrieves information about the song you're currently listening to on Last.fm.

medias.medias: The Medias module allows you to download videos and music from various popular platforms such as YouTube and TikTok. Easily, you can request the download of multimedia content directly in the chat. The bot will take care of the download process and send the file to you as soon as it's ready.
medias.youtube: The YouTube module allows you to download videos and music directly from YouTube. With a simple command, you can request the download of any video or music available on the platform. Main commands: - /ytdl [video URL or title]: Downloads the YouTube video or music based on the provided URL or title, and in the chosen quality.
medias.tiktok: The TikTok module allows you to download videos directly from TikTok. You can request the download of any video available on the platform. Just send me the link of the desired video, and I will send you the downloaded file directly in the chat.

miscellaneous.miscellaneous: The Miscellaneous module includes a variety of useful features that don't fit into other specific categories. It contains tools and resources to enhance your experience with the bot, providing practical solutions for different needs.
miscellaneous.gsmarena: The GSMArena module allows you to access detailed information about a wide range of mobile devices. You can search for specifications, features, and reviews of smartphones directly in the chat, making it easier to compare and choose the ideal device for you. Main commands: - /d [device model]: Searches for information about the specified mobile device using data provided by the GSMArena database.
miscellaneous.translator: The Translator module allows you to translate text between different languages directly in the chat. You can specify the target language and the text you want to translate, and the bot will provide you with the translated version, making communication easier across language barriers. Main commands: - /tr [language code / PEP 639-1] [text]: Translates the provided text into the specified target language. If no target language is specified, it will be translated to the native language of the chat. • You can use this command by replying to a message, and the text of the replied message will be translated into the specified target language or the native language of the chat if no target language is provided.
miscellaneous.weather: The Weather module provides up-to-date weather information for any desired location. You can get weather forecasts, current conditions, and other relevant data directly in the chat, helping you plan your day better. Main commands: - /weather | /clima [location]: Gets the current weather conditions and forecast for the specified location.
miscellaneous.upload: The Upload module allows you to upload files to the chat using a direct URL. With a simple command, you can request the upload of any file available online, and the bot will take care of the download and upload process, sending the file directly to you in the chat. Main commands: - /upload [direct file URL]: Downloads the file from the provided URL and uploads it to the chat as a document.

pm-menu.about-text: — %s I am a multifunctional bot created to bring fun and practicality to your conversations. With a wide range of commands, I'm here to make your day easier and transform your experience on Telegram. Developed with the power of Go, my structure utilizes the Telego library and integrates directly with the Telegram BOT API. You can contribute to this project in different ways, whether by suggesting and implementing new features through Pull Requests, or even financially supporting us. For more information, click the buttons below.
pm-menu.privacy-text: %s Privacy Policy: This bot was designed and created to ensure your safety and privacy. Thank you for your trust, our organization values the protection of your data, in addition, we value quality. Click the button below to check out the regulation issued by Telegram, used by this bot.
pm-menu.start-private: Hello %s, I'am %s. A robot with cool and fun functions for your chat. Click the buttons below to learn more about me.
